cleaner.label: Pipenv (Python)
cleaner.description: The virtual environments created by Pipenv. Does not touch projects, Pipfiles or Pipfile.lock files.

option.label: Pipenv virtual environments
option.description: Removes all the virtual environments in Pipenv's environments folder.
option.warning: The projects that use them stop working until you run `pipenv install` again in each one. If the folder is shared with other tools that use WORKON_HOME, their environments are removed too.
